connector.name: B4 Index
connector.registryDescription: Independent build-vs-buy index: score software categories BUILD/BUY/BRIDGE/BEWARE.
connector.summary: Hosted at b4-index.vercel.app over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.benroberts, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer <b4_... key>' unlocks the Pro workflow tools (b4_audit, b4_compare, b4_recommend). The free tier (b4_browse, b4_score) needs no credentials.
